Reports of Explosions Near Iran's Kharg Island Oil Terminal

Reports emerged of explosions near the Kharg island region, a major oil hub in Iran. Iranian media stated that blasts were heard in the area, though they noted no smoke was visible. The SNN news agency claimed that the United States targeted an Iranian tanker. Other reports mentioned the destruction of an Iranian radar and the existence of an underground nuclear facility, alongside warnings from the US Oval Office and condemnations from Iran regarding US strikes.
